name: toolkit
description: Codex-ready optional utilities from Agent Workshop: doc-to-html, ui-demo-video, arch-map, and writing-skills (derived from obra/superpowers, MIT).

interface.longDescription: A Codex manifest for the Agent Workshop toolkit plugin. Codex exposes the doc-to-html, ui-demo-video, arch-map, and writing-skills skills from this package — the optional artifact-making layer next to the toolkit plugin.
defaultPrompt: Turn a markdown report into a standalone HTML page.
Draw an architecture map of a subsystem or refactor as a standalone page.
Record a UI demo video of a change in the running app.
Author or edit a skill with baseline testing.
